About D6 Events

We handle the details, so you can hold the moment

D6 Events is a full-service event management studio built around one idea: a celebration should feel effortless for the people living it. We work closely with couples and families through decor, vendors, logistics and the run-of-show, so nothing is left to chance on the day itself.

From an intimate engagement at home to a full wedding across multiple venues and days, our team plans the sequence, styles the space and stays on the ground until the last guest leaves.

How it works

From first call to final send-off

i.

Discovery call

We learn your date, guest count, venue and the feel you're after.

ii.

Design & budget

A concept, decor mood and a clear line-item budget, before anything is booked.

iii.

Vendor & logistics

We book, brief and manage every vendor so you deal with one point of contact — us.

iv.

On the day

Our team runs the show from setup to teardown, so you're free to be a guest at your own event.
